params.description: Date of IPO in YYYY-MM-DD format (new preferred parameter)

params.name: parameters[ipo_date]
params.description: Date of IPO in YYYY-MM-DD format (deprecated)

items.docs: Returns Initial Public Offering (IPO) data including pricing information, underwriters, deal status, and offering details

params.name: page
params.description: Page offset. For optimization, performance and technical reasons, page offsets are limited from 0 - 100000. Limit the query results by other parameters such as date

params.name: parameters[date]
params.description: Date to query for calendar data. Shorthand for date_from and date_to if they are the same. Defaults for latest

params.name: parameters[date_from]
params.description: Date to query from point in time

params.name: parameters[date_to]
params.description: Date to query to point in time

params.name: parameters[tickers]
params.description: One or more ticker symbols separated by a comma. Maximum 50 tickers. Note that new tickers may not return results right away

params.name: parameters[ipo_type]
params.description: One or more IPO types separated by a comma. Example: Ordinary Shares,SPAC

params.name: parameters[updated]
params.description: Records last Updated Unix timestamp (UTC). This will force the sort order to be Greater Than or Equal to the timestamp indicated

items.docs: Returns Initial Public Offering (IPO) data including pricing information, underwriters, deal status, and offering details. IPOs represent when a private company first offers shares to the public. Note that for the IPOs endpoint, new tickers may not return results right away as they are not automatically linked to the underlying company's data. To obtain the most recent rows, send queries without the tickers parameter specified.
